item.name: Get all XBRL facts for a company

request.name: Get all XBRL facts for a company

description.content: Returns all XBRL disclosures for a company across all reporting periods, organized by taxonomy (us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei, srt) and concept name. Each concept contains an array of facts with values, units, filing accession numbers, and period dates. This is the primary endpoint for retrieving historical financial statement data for a given company.

response.name: All XBRL facts for the company

description.content: (Required) Central Index Key (CIK) with leading zeros to reach 10 digits.

info.name: SEC EDGAR Data Company Concept Company Facts API

description.content:
The EDGAR Data API at data.sec.gov provides RESTful access to public company financial filings, XBRL structured financial data, and company metadata without requiring authentication or API keys. The API delivers JSON-formatted responses covering company submissions (filing history), XBRL financial facts across all reporting periods, single XBRL concept values over time, and cross-company comparative frames for US-GAAP and IFRS taxonomies.
